HERE TO HELP

QUESTIONS.

Ask us something else
Who do you work with?

Councils, trusts, charities, community hubs and volunteer groups that want to get more people active.

Can you run a whole event for us?

Yes. We arrange and manage holiday programmes and community sports events from start to finish, so you can focus on your community.

Can programmes be tailored to our group?

Yes. Programmes are shaped around your people, space and goals, and are inclusive by design for all ages.

Can Proteus help our organisation beyond coaching?

Yes. Alongside coaching we offer operational support and sports business capability: strategic and governance support, sports management and recruitment, sports marketing and promotion, and organisational development to help you build sustainable programmes.

People first.
Development always.
